claim: Mean movement during the first active 12 h after the first cage change is negatively associated with later CombZ.
population: All animals with a resolvable first-night window and a CombZ endpoint (n=111)
temporal_scope: First Active phase block after first cage change; fixed clock window 18:30-06:30, 12 h
sensitivity_resolution: 5min - AVAILABLE. rho -0.3896 vs -0.3903 at 10 min; BH-supported at both.
model: Spearman rank correlation with bootstrap CI
res_sus_outcome_derived: yes - Group is endpoint-derived from CombZ and is excluded from all canonical primary models
remaining_caveat: Association, not causation. CombZ is a downstream composite; RES/SUS labels derive from it.
notes: Stage 16 validation check canonical_feature_registry PASS: exactly three canonical features in required order.

claim: Movement RMSSD over the same window is negatively associated with later CombZ.
temporal_scope: First active 12 h after first cage change
sensitivity_resolution: 5min - AVAILABLE. rho -0.3020 vs -0.2255 at 10 min; BH-supported at both. Lag-1-bin statistic, so the 5-min value measures a 5-min lag.
model: Spearman rank correlation with bootstrap CI
remaining_caveat: Supporting association only; not demonstrated as an independent predictive contributor.
notes: Must not be described as an independent predictor.

claim: Entropy persistence (ACF1) over the same window is associated with later CombZ.
temporal_scope: First active 12 h after first cage change
sensitivity_resolution: 5min - AVAILABLE. rho -0.3141 vs -0.1747 at 10 min; BH-supported at 5 min (q=0.0012) but NOT at 10 min (q=0.0667). Lag-1-bin statistic, so this is not the same construct.
model: Spearman rank correlation with bootstrap CI
current_status: NOT BH-supported; bootstrap CI includes zero
remaining_caveat: Must be reported with the qualified wording at the PRIMARY resolution. Any claim that Entropy_acf1 is significant in the primary analysis is false. The 5-min sensitivity IS BH-supported, but Entropy_acf1 is a lag-1-BIN statistic, so the 5-min version measures entropy persistence at a 5-min lag rather than the 10-min lag of the primary. That is a different quantity, not a better-powered estimate of the same one, and it must NOT be used to promote the primary result.
publication_ready: yes as a qualified negative/inconclusive result; NOT as a positive finding
notes: Stage 16 validation check entropy_wording PASS enforces the required qualified wording.

claim: A fixed a priori behaviour-only model using mean movement predicts later CombZ out of sample.
temporal_scope: First active 12 h after first cage change
sensitivity_resolution: 5min - AVAILABLE and completed. Same fixed window, feature family, model registry and resampling contract; reported as supplementary evidence in Stage 16. See analysis_ready/pipeline/09_early_prediction/5min/ and its audit/stage09_resolution_sensitivity_comparison.csv.
model: Fixed a priori behaviour-only model registry; LOAO and repeated grouped 5-fold CV
effect_size: LOAO out-of-sample R2 = 0.1593946 vs training-fold mean; repeated 5-fold CV mean R2 = 0.1558227 [0.1159, 0.1790]; permutation p = 1/1001
res_sus_outcome_derived: yes - Group excluded from the model
remaining_caveat: Internal validation only, not external validation. Prospective association/prediction, not causal inference. Resolution sensitivity now RESOLVED: LOAO R2 0.1594 at 10 min vs 0.1600 at 5 min (delta 0.0006), permutation p = 1/1001 at both. Movement_mean is lag-free and therefore directly comparable across resolutions.
notes: Stage 16 checks movement_mean_headline PASS, permutation_display PASS (exact 1/1001 retained), group_excluded_primary_prediction PASS.

claim: The fixed three-feature behaviour-only model predicts later CombZ out of sample.
temporal_scope: First active 12 h after first cage change
sensitivity_resolution: 5min - AVAILABLE and completed. Same fixed window, feature family, model registry and resampling contract; reported as supplementary evidence in Stage 16. See analysis_ready/pipeline/09_early_prediction/5min/ and its audit/stage09_resolution_sensitivity_comparison.csv.
model: Fixed a priori model: Movement_mean + Movement_rmssd + Entropy_acf1
effect_size: LOAO out-of-sample R2 = 0.1524453; repeated 5-fold CV mean R2 = 0.1479031 [0.1028, 0.1800]; permutation p = 1/1001
current_status: Permutation-supported but does NOT improve on Movement_mean alone (0.1524 vs 0.1594)
remaining_caveat: No model-comparison significance test was performed. Must not be described as an improvement over the movement-only model. Resolution sensitivity RESOLVED: LOAO R2 0.1524 at 10 min vs 0.1717 at 5 min. Note the 5-min model is NOT the same construct - it contains two lag-1-bin features whose lag halves with the bin width - so the gain must not be read as the 10-min model performing better than reported.
notes: Sex-adjusted variants exist as sensitivities (R2 0.1524 and 0.1423) with no permutation test specified.

contrast_or_endpoint: RES-CON, SUS-CON, SUS-RES within Sex, across 5 displayed domains
multiplicity_family: BH with explicitly declared n: FIRST_NIGHT__Female/Male__DISPLAYED_5x3 (n=15 each); interaction family DISPLAYED_5 (n=5); transparency sensitivity ALL_RAW_8x3 (n=24 each)
effect_size: 0 of 30 displayed cells FDR-supported; min q = 0.0893. Strongest cell: Female RES-CON, Behavioral volatility / fragmentation, Hedges g = -0.844, raw p = 0.00595, q = 0.0893. 6 cells nominally p<0.05. CORRECTED 2026-09-23: the earlier 'g = -1.0093, raw p = 0.001341, q = 0.020108' predated both the CombZ correction and the leading-bin rebuild.

Three additional raw candidates are audit-only and never displayed. Phase rule is exact membership, not substring matching. SUPERSEDED FOR PRIMARY USE 2026-09-23 by FIRSTNIGHT_4DOMAIN_CORE; preserved unchanged as the legacy flat-family sensitivity.

claim: First-night latent-state dwell time differs by group.
population: 109 animals with a first-night dwell value
temporal_scope: First active 12 h after first cage change
model: HMM dwell extracted from the shipped fit, compared against a seed-7 refit
contrast_or_endpoint: Animal-level dwell agreement; RES-CON/SUS-CON/SUS-RES within Sex
effect_size: Shipped vs refit Spearman rho = 0.0154; mean dwell 32.06 vs 16.51 min (1.94x). Contrast estimates and nominal p-values are not stable across seeds.

claim: The primary prospective result is not an artifact of the 10-min bin width.
population: n=111, the same animals and endpoint identity contract as the primary
temporal_scope: Identical: first Active phase block after first cage change, 18:30-06:30, 12 h
sensitivity_resolution: 5min (144 slots vs 72; identical 12 h clock window)
model: Identical fixed a priori registry and resampling contract (LOAO, 100x repeated grouped 5-fold CV, 1000 full-refit outcome permutations, seed 20260811, 5000 bootstrap)
contrast_or_endpoint: Same three canonical features and same three models versus CombZ
multiplicity_family: Same families, recomputed within the sensitivity; never pooled with the primary
effect_size: Movement_mean rho -0.3903 -> -0.3896, LOAO R2 0.1594 -> 0.1600, permutation p 1/1001 at both; Movement_rmssd rho -0.2255 -> -0.3020; Entropy_acf1 rho -0.1747 -> -0.3141; 3-feature LOAO R2 0.1524 -> 0.1717; mean-only baseline identical at both
res_sus_outcome_derived: yes - Group excluded from all models, as in the primary
current_status: COMPLETED. Direction stable for every feature and every model; the headline Movement_mean result is essentially unchanged.
remaining_caveat: Movement_rmssd and Entropy_acf1 are lag-1-BIN statistics, so at 5 min they measure a 5-min lag rather than a 10-min lag: for those two features this is a partly different construct, not purely finer sampling. Movement_mean is lag-free and directly comparable. Entropy_acf1 becomes BH-supported at 5 min; this must NOT be used to reinterpret the primary. Movement is an extensive per-bin count, so its absolute scale halves; rank correlations are unaffected but coefficients and axes are not. Window completeness differs mechanically (50/111 animals complete at 10 min vs 33/111 at 5 min) because a finer grid resolves the same post-18:30 entry delay into more missing leading slots; interior and trailing gaps are zero at BOTH resolutions. CORRECTED 2026-09-23: the completeness figures quoted above (50/111 at 10 min vs 33/111 at 5 min) are PRE-leading-bin-fix. Completeness is now 111/111 at BOTH resolutions, and the count rule now agrees with the clock window for 111/111 animals at both.
publication_ready: yes as a supplementary resolution sensitivity
notes: Run with the identical script; only bin_level changed. The 10-min canonical tree was not re-run and all 86 of its files remain byte-identical. Stage 16 exports these as SUPPLEMENTARY rows (S09_SENS5MIN_*) and never into the primary registry; validation check resolution_sensitivity_status now reports Available.

claim: During the first night after the first cage change, four raw-RFID behavioural domains do not differ by later-outcome group within either sex once batch and cage dependence are modelled.
population: n=111 animals, all with complete 72-slot windows; proximity-dependent domains n=109 (OQ770 and OQ771 were singly housed at CC1, so ProximityFraction is structurally undefined and correctly NA)
temporal_scope: CC1, first Active phase block, 18:30 inclusive to 06:30 exclusive, exactly 12 h
sensitivity_resolution: 5min - a DIFFERENT temporal construct for the six rmssd/acf1 features (lag-in-bin), not a replication of the 10-min construct
model: lmerTest::lmer(DomainScore ~ Group + factor(Batch) + (1|CageEpochID)) within Sex; legacy-LM, Batch-LM and clubSandwich CR2 cluster-robust variants reported alongside
contrast_or_endpoint: Group omnibus per domain; RES-CON, SUS-CON and SUS-RES exported with 95% CIs and Hedges g, gated on the parent omnibus
multiplicity_family: HIERARCHICAL: BH over exactly 4 domain omnibus Group tests per Sex, then Holm over the 3 pairwise contrasts WITHIN a supported domain; Group:Sex interaction family n=4
effect_size: 0 of 8 domain omnibus tests supported; min q = 0.516. Female Cross-channel volatility raw p 0.043 (legacy LM) -> 0.035 (batch-adjusted) -> 0.129 (cage RI) -> 0.329 (CR2)
res_sus_outcome_derived: yes - RES/SUS are defined by LATER CombZ, so every contrast is characterisation, not prospective validation
current_status: COMPLETE. Interpretable null under cage-aware inference.
remaining_caveat: CON animals are cage-segregated at every cage change, so RES-CON and SUS-CON are BETWEEN-CAGE contrasts resting on 6 control cages; SUS-RES is the only within-cage-identified contrast. Sex is perfectly nested in Batch, so no Sex MAIN effect is estimable or claimed. 14 of 24 pairwise contrasts change sign under leave-one-batch-out.
publication_ready: yes as a characterisation panel, reported as a null with the model ladder shown
notes: Four CORE domains: Spatial entropy dynamics, Social-spatial organization, Cross-channel behavioral volatility, Movement output. The three composite formulas are IDENTICAL to the audited legacy ones; only the labels changed. The legacy fifth domain (Active-phase adaptation / exploration) is EXCLUDED on construct grounds - a single 12 h level/persistence composite does not operationally measure adaptation - and NOT on any p-value. Phenotype-blind construct audit: stop_for_review = FALSE, 0 between-domain redundancy flags at |rho| >= 0.85.

claim: Across four repeated cage changes the acute 12 h behavioural response changes markedly overall, but the trajectory does not differ by later-outcome group in either sex.
population: n=111 animals x 4 cage changes = 444 acute windows, all 72/72 slots complete; proximity-dependent domains 441
temporal_scope: First Active 12 h block after EACH of CC1-CC4 under the identical clock rule; verified lag 0.00 h from session start for all 24 sessions
sensitivity_resolution: 5min - a DIFFERENT temporal construct for the six rmssd/acf1 features (lag-in-bin), not a replication of the 10-min construct
contrast_or_endpoint: Joint Group x CageChange interaction per domain; predeclared change-from-CC1 follow-ups gated on the parent
multiplicity_family: BH over exactly 4 Group x CageChange tests per Sex; Group x Sex x CageChange family n=4
effect_size: 0 of 8 trajectory tests supported; min q = 0.823. Male Movement output raw p 0.0085 (animal-only) -> 0.343 (cage-adjusted)
res_sus_outcome_derived: yes - RES/SUS are defined by LATER CombZ, so every contrast is characterisation, not prospective validation
current_status: COMPLETE. Strong shared CageChange main effect; no phenotype-specific trajectory.
remaining_caveat: CON animals keep identical cage-mates across CC1-CC4 (Jaccard 1.000, 72/72 transitions) while RES and SUS are fully reshuffled, so any Group x CageChange effect confounds stress phenotype with repeated novel-social-group exposure. Cage variance dominates animal variance for the social-spatial domain.
publication_ready: yes as a characterisation panel, reported as a shared-adaptation null
notes: Adaptation is measured as CHANGE across repeated cage changes. Scaling is FIXED from the CC1 within-Sex distribution and applied unchanged to CC1-CC4; it is never re-estimated per cage change. CC1 scores reproduce the first-night scores exactly (contract test 16). A pooled-across-CC scaling sensitivity is also reported.
